answer_1.quote: Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) is a key step in conversational search, aiming to rewrite vague queries in conversation into de-contextualized queries, thereby promoting conversational search.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluated the performance of the models on four metrics: MRR, NDCG@3, Recall@10, and R@100.
